mark_split.label: Find a and r and state the nth term formula

recall_prompt: Say how you would do this one — name the formula for the nth term of a G.P. and say what a and r are here.

page_header: Section A — Very Short Answer Question

steps.label: Find a and r and state the nth term formula
steps.margin_note: First mark. Both a and r must be named. Divide to get the ratio, never subtract — an A.P. has a common difference, a G.P. has a common ratio.
steps.memory_tip: The power on r is one less than the term number, because the first term carries no r.
lines: The nth term of a G.P. is  tₙ = arⁿ⁻¹

recall.must_convey: That a = 4, r = 2, and the nth term of a G.P. is arⁿ⁻¹.
accept: first term is four and the common ratio is two
divide the second term by the first to get the ratio
the nth term of a G P is a r to the power n minus one
ratio ki divide cheyyali, so r equals two
state the nth term formula before substituting
heard_as: a r to the n minus one

steps.why: The ratio has to be read off the given terms before any formula is used, and writing tₙ = arⁿ⁻¹ earns a mark on its own even if the arithmetic then slips.
common_mistakes: Taking r as 8 − 4 = 4, which is a common difference and belongs to an A.P.
Writing the nth term as arⁿ, which returns the 6th term when n = 5.

steps.label: Substitute n = 5
steps.margin_note: Second mark. Show ar⁴ before the number. Writing the terms out — 4, 8, 16, 32, 64 — is a fair check of the answer.
steps.memory_tip: Doubling 4 four times gives 8, 16, 32, 64, and 64 is the fifth term.

accept: the fifth term is a r to the fourth
four times two to the fourth is sixty four
two to the power four is sixteen and four sixteens are sixty four
four into sixteen equals sixty four vasthundi

steps.why: With a = 4 and r = 2 the fourth power of 2 is 16, so the whole answer is one multiplication. Writing 2⁴ before evaluating it keeps the power visible for the examiner.
common_mistakes: Multiplying the power instead of raising it: 4 × 2 × 4 = 32.
Using 2⁵ = 32 and giving 128, which is the 6th term.
